note.zh-TW: 模板原文寫「資產統計」，「統計」是「總計」的用詞錯誤；網站顯示修正寫法，模板原字列為別名。
note.en: The template label uses a wrong word for total; the site shows the corrected wording and keeps the original as a searchable alias.

definition.zh-TW: 公司所有資產加起來的金額。它必須等於負債與股東權益的總計（勾稽點 D），也是負債比率與總資產週轉率的分母。
definition.en: The sum of all the company's assets. It must equal total liabilities and equity (check D) and is the denominator of the debt ratio and total asset turnover.
